items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: I walked in and walked right up to Cal and said, “I’d like to sit in.” ... So I sat in and I wound up, he hired me. ... I think I played five or six of those jam session things that they did.

ctx.x: Let’s see. Cal Tjader. You moved out the west coast?

No I was visiting the west coast. My parents decided to take a cross country drive, and last minute I decided to go with them. And I had heard about this music called “west coast jazz” so I wanted to check that out. So we arrived in San Francisco, my aunt and uncle lived there and we were staying with them, and I read about this place called the Black Hawk, which is where Brubeck got his start and Cal Tjader happened to be playing there. And I didn’t know who Cal Tjader was, but I went down there and took my…
And which horn did you have?
